answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock: each new identity deposits 50 credits, locked until it builds a fingerprint. A prism splits activity into timing, counterparties, and task mix; clones share one pattern and stay locked. The velvet rope admits only fingerprints differing by 20% or more. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 credits plus 100 fake histories; one honest agent pays 50 once. Real activity is the ember that burns on; copies starve.
